item.title: Eagle Tavern to Host 2nd Annual Fundraiser for Pottsville Fire Department
item.description: After a successful inaugural event last year, Eagle Tavern has announced the return of its 2nd Annual Pottsville Fire Department Fundraiser, set for Tuesday, February 24th through Saturday, February 28th. During the five-day event, the downtown restaurant and bar will donate 10% of all sales directly to the Pottsville Fire Department. item.title: Yuengling to Release Eagle Series #16: American Stout
item.description: D.G. Yuengling & Son has announced the release of Eagle Series #16: American Stout, the latest installment in the brewery’s limited-run lineup produced at America’s Oldest Brewery. The newest Eagle Series offering is a traditional stout brewed with pale malt, barley flakes, roasted barley, and black malt. item.title: Two Schuylkill County Law Enforcement Agencies Participating in ICE 287(g) Program; One Listed as Pending
item.description: Two law enforcement agencies in Schuylkill County are currently listed as participants in U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement’s (ICE) 287(g) program, according to federal data updated this week. The U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) reports that the Mahanoy City Borough Police Department and the Schuylkill County Sheriff’s Office have signed Memorandums of Agreement (MOAs) under the 287(g) program. item.description: A Winter Storm Watch has been issued by the National Weather Service for Schuylkill County and counties south in central Pennsylvania, with heavy snow possible from late Saturday night through Monday afternoon. item.title: PennDOT Announces Blasting Operations on Route 61 Reconstruction Project Between St. Clair and Frackville
item.description: Motorists traveling on Route 61 between St. Clair and Frackville should prepare for brief delays this week due to scheduled blasting operations. According to PennDOT, several short-term traffic stoppages of approximately 15 minutes each will occur in both directions along PA 61 as part of the ongoing Route 61 St. Clair–Frackville Reconstruction Project. The work will take place between St. Clair Borough and Frackville Borough on: Wednesday, February 25, 2026Thursday, February 26, 2026
